module.note: XIAO nRF52840 Sense soldered flat on the top face (toward the head), USB-C down; its shell overhangs the bottom edge 1.2

usb.note: XIAO USB-C mouth at the board's bottom edge, through the pod's bottom face (reached under the sweatband)

mic.note: the Sense's PDM mic on the XIAO's top face: felt-covered acoustic opening in the pod's inner face over the module

button.note: PTS810 MODE button: a flexure key in the pod's inner face presses it (under the sweatband)

plug_a.note: JST PH side-entry SMD (S3B-PH-SM4-TB), mouth flush with the -x edge: band half A (wearer's right)

plug_b.note: JST PH side-entry SMD, mouth flush with the +x edge: band half B (wearer's left)

cells.note: cell lead pads at x +-22.4; the two 6 x 34 x 50 LiPo pouches sit off-board in the pod's wings, centred 68 mm of arc either side of the back centre (near ends ~31 mm from the centre, clear of the plugs' mating housings)

band.note: off-board: two flex matrices of 12 x 104 meeting at the back seam; screen z 3.0-36.6, band 39.6 tall; 178 x 204 mm oval at the brim seam, leaning in 7 deg

model.note: fit_model.solidcraft = model.solidcraft without the 219 louvres and 312 pixel tiles (build_model.py --fit). They all sit on the band's outer face, outside the Screen body, which the check still includes, so the quicker check misses nothing
